training_data_sources.rainfall: Synthetic gamma distribution (shape=1.8, scale=35) loosely matching IMD monsoon 7-day accum for Assam
training_data_sources.river_level: Synthetic beta distribution (alpha=2, beta=5) loosely matching CWC gauge ranges on Beki/Manas/Kaldia
training_data_sources.soil_moisture: Synthetic beta distribution (alpha=3, beta=2) loosely matching NASA SMAP range for Assam
training_data_sources.elevation: SRTM 30m DEM statistics for Barpeta district (used for hazard exposure param)
training_data_sources.distance_to_river: HydroSHEDS/Bhuvan river network distances (used for hazard exposure param)
training_data_sources.population_vulnerability: Census 2011 + SECC 2011 village statistics for Barpeta (used for vuln/pop params)
training_data_sources.historical_flood_events: ASDMA flood records summary (used for hazard exposure param, NOT for training labels)

disclaimer: Model trained on SYNTHETIC data from parametric distributions and heuristic threshold labels. NOT trained on actual IMD/CWC/NASA/ASDMA records. NOT official CWC/ASDMA/NDMA flood zonation.
